senses.gloss: जुष् [cf. γεύομαι; Zd. zaosha; Hib. gus; Goth. kiusu; Lat. gus-tus.]
2. जुष् mfn. ifc. liking, fond of, devoted to (once with acc. BhP. vii, 6, 25; cf. निकृतिं-), BhP.; Bhartṛ.; Śāntiś.; Kathās.
dwelling in Hcar. vii
visiting, approaching, BhP. ii, 7, 25; Madhus.
having, showing, Bālar. iv, 17; ix, 25; Siṃhās. Introd. 5l; xv, 4; Kuval. 169
similar, Hcar. i, 44
cf. स-.
जूष् cl. 1. P. v.l. for √ यूष्.
जुष mfn. See अलं॑-
प्रीति-जुषा.
जूष n. (cf. जुष्कक) = यूष, L.
जुषाण॑ m. N. of a sacrificial formula containing the word जुषाण॑ (aor. p.), ŚBr. i; AitBr. i, 17; ŚāṅkhŚr. i, 8, 9.
जूषण n. Grislea tomentosa, L.
जुषाण—वत् mfn. id., ĀpŚr. vi, 31, Sch.
जु॑ष्ट mfn. (˚ष्ट॑, RV. ix, 42, 2; AV. and in later language, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 209 f.) pleased, propitious, RV. ix, 42, 2
liked, wished, loved, welcome, agreeable, usual (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 188; Kār.; with dat. or gen., rarely instr.), RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.
frequented, visited, inhabited, MBh.; R.; BhP.
swept over (by the wind), Hariv. 6984
afflicted by (instr. or in comp.), Suśr.
served, obliged, worshipped, W.
practised, W.
furnished with, possessed of (instr. or in comp.), R. iii; BhP.
जु॑ष्ट n. the remnants of a meal, L.
cf. अ॑-.
जुष्टा or जुष्टि, f. also N. of a cow, Lāṭy.; Drāhy.
जु॑ष्ट—तम (जु॑ष्˚), mfn. (superl.) most welcome, RV.
जु॑ष्ट—तर (जु॑ष्˚), mfn. (compar.) id., viii, 96, 11.
जुष्टा or जुष्टि, f. also N. of a cow, Lāṭy.; Drāhy.
जु॑ष्टि f. love, service, favour, satisfaction, i, 10, 12; vii, 33, 4; x, 114, 1; AV.; TS. i; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Lāṭy.
जुष्य mfn. fut. p.p. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 109.
जुष्क m. N. of one of the 3 Kaśmīrian Turuṣka kings, Rājat. i, 168 f.
जुष्क—पुर n. N. of a town founded by Juṣka, ib.
जुष्कक m. = जूष, L.
